Subject: Post-demo: Reranking & Embeddings comparison vs hyperscalers - next tests

Hi Alex, Priya ---

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Recap
- Goal: Determine where Redwood's retrieval + reranking flow improves recall and cost vs the hyperscaler APIs you're testing.
- Key success criteria you mentioned: recall@5 >= 0.75 on your query set, end-to-end P95 retrieval+rerank latency < 100ms, and predictable cost at 500k queries/month.

Proposed next tests (we can run these on Hosted or Dedicated POC):
1) End-to-end retrieval + rerank with your ~10k document snapshot (same queries you used in the demo) -- measure recall@1/5/10 and end-to-end P50/P95 latencies.
2) Dimensionality sweep: embeddings at 768 vs 1536 dims (and quantized int8/float16 variants) to show cost vs recall tradeoffs.
3) Retrieval-only baseline (ANN) + rerank with a small cross-encoder on top -- measure throughput and latency.

Attachments: rerank_test_plan.md (test matrix + scripts), rough_cost_model.csv (ballpark cost numbers)

Next steps
- If that plan looks good, we can spin a Dedicated POC pool and run your 10k job this week. Marissa and Aditya are copied to scope infra and cost.
- Can you confirm the dataset format (Parquet vs JSONL) and how you want to share the snapshot (S3 presign or our secure upload)?

I'll follow up internally to get a concrete run schedule.

Thanks ---

Sean Gallagher

Alex ---

Answers inline: 
- Yes, we can run both the 10k and 100k jobs in the POC. For the hosted POC we'll run on a temporary Dedicated pool to keep isolation and consistent latency; for Private/VPC we can provide the same test harness but will need your infra lead to coordinate.
- Ballpark cost delta: moving from 768 -> 1536 dims roughly doubles storage and ANN index memory. For 500k q/mo our rough model (attached) shows embedding storage + ANN ops increase related costs ~1.8-2.1x depending on quantization. We'll have Aditya provide a more precise number for your corpus.
- VPC/private: for a short POC we can either: a) host vectors on Redwood-managed encrypted storage (fastest to start) or b) deploy a Private connector so vectors remain in your VPC. Option (b) is possible but adds setup time (~2-3 business days).

If S3 presign works, send the link and we'll schedule the first run. Proposed run window: Thu 2/19 morning PST -- does that work?

Sean

Subject: Internal: POC benchmark plan and metric definitions (Acme)

Folks --- looping you in with a more concrete benchmark matrix to run once Sean gets the S3 presign. Key measurements we should produce and include in the customer deliverable:

Metrics (end-to-end retrieval + rerank):
- Recall@1, @5, @10 (primary) --- compute with the customer query set and relevance labels.
- Latency: P50 and P95 end-to-end (retrieval + rerank), plus ANN-only P95.
- Throughput: QPS sustainable at target latency buckets (e.g., P95 < 100ms).
- Index memory and storage: RAM usage for ANN index + disk for embedding store; report by vector dim and quantization format.
- Cost metrics: per-query cost (USD) at 500k q/mo, plus 1M-vector storage cost for 768 vs 1536 dims and quantized options.

Test matrix suggestions:
- Corpus sizes: 10k (customer snapshot), 100k (scale test).
- Embedding dims: 768, 1536.
- Quantization: float16, int8.
- Reranker model: small cross-encoder (approx 50-100ms per rerank op) vs a low-latency distilled cross-encoder.

Deliverables: CSV with recall/latency breakdowns, a short slide with tradeoffs, and rough cost model (we can use rough_cost_model.csv for initial numbers).

Dylan/Eng: please prepare a runbook and time estimate. Aditya --- can you provide the per-dimension storage & compute deltas for the attached rough_cost_model?

Attachment: benchmark_matrix.xlsx

Marissa Cole
